claim: Hyperposition requires one specific graph/hypergraph storage form.
result: not supported: temporal log and faceted index both exact on tested semantic queries

claim: Temporal-log scan cost is generically ~341x faceted projection.
result: not replicated in independent workload; ID scan ratio temporal/faceted=3.55x, OOD=4.25x

claim: A fixed coupling kappa transfers across tasks.
result: contradicted: prior G2 proxy kappa=0.9 vs current G3 independent toy kappa=0.5

claim: Outcome/reentry flag alone yields gain.
result: no effect in arms lacking usable coupling; information path matters

claim: Presence of GWT stages is sufficient episode validation.
result: presence baseline rejected only 13.33% of 9000 causal mutants

claim: RAE-8.8 package self-test is internally consistent as shipped.
result: false: original test requires absent RAE-8.6 master; compatibility self-test passes RAE-8.8 package

claim: Hypothesis/Z3 were installed for this run.
result: false: isolated pip acquisition failed on runtime mirror; fallback tools only

claim: Running the V17 candidate gate under python3 -O renders its guarantee vacuous, because all asserts are stripped and 14 of 18 checks are hardcoded True.
result: false: tested by disabling the Python attempt guard and running under -O. The schema trigger V17_REENTRY_CANONICAL_BINDING_MISMATCH still aborted the transaction. The -O exposure is a reporting defect, not a safety hole. Reviewer hypothesis falsified.

claim: An evaluator, interpreter, lowering stage or code generator for .clay exists somewhere in the Dr.-Unterweger checkout.
result: false: repo-wide search found none. structured_frontend_v1.py (112 lines, Lark) terminates at a TypedIR dictionary. Under CLAYCODE_ONLY cognition the loop core has no executable substrate, consistent with F-V01-03 = OPEN.

claim: The Python EffectGate and claycode/frank_effects.clay may have drifted apart, since nothing ever compared them.
result: false for decide_effect: 200,576 requests compared on the target VPS with 0 mismatches. The two implementations agree on every sampled point of the request space.

claim: The new differential gate might be green by construction, like the receipts criticized in the preceding audit.
result: false: sabotaging the .clay source turns it red. DENY->ALLOW on WIPE_DEVICE gives 7 mismatches; dropping ONE conjunct in destructive_guard_complete gives 1 mismatch in 3,576. Sensitivity demonstrated, not asserted.

claim: runtime/clay_wp03_exact_bundle/tools/claycode_base_frontend.py is present in the Frank repo, as a workflow hash assertion implies.
result: false: absent at main. It exists only in the Clay repo under tools/. Two commits named 'bundle(wp03): restore exact V18 frontend' show it has been lost before. structured_frontend_v1.py imports it and therefore cannot run standalone in the Frank repo. The new evaluator avoids the dependency entirely.

claim: WAL capability can be probed on an in-memory SQLite database.
result: false: an in-memory database legitimately refuses WAL and reports journal_mode 'memory'. A healthy build read as WAL-unavailable. Capability probes must run on the storage class they make claims about. Instrument bug, found and fixed.

claim: Post-crash writability can be measured through a pysqlite connection using default isolation_level.
result: false: pysqlite opens its own implicit transaction before the INSERT, so an explicit BEGIN IMMEDIATE raises 'cannot start a transaction within a transaction'. This read as 'database not writable after crash' in all 10 cycles - a false durability alarm. Requires isolation_level=None. A storage claim measured through a driver's convenience layer measures the driver.

claim: Any committed transaction absent from the acknowledgement log is a phantom.
result: false: a transaction that COMMITs and is killed before its log fsync is present-but-unacknowledged by design. Counting those as phantoms produced 6 false positives. Because each writer commits sequentially, at most one such record can exist per writer; that window is now measured separately. An oracle must model its own observation window or it reports the window as a defect.

claim: The four GWT control arms might pass by construction, like the receipts criticised in the 2026-08-11 audit.
result: false: two sabotages turn the gate red. (a) Breaking the SHUFFLED control ITSELF so it no longer shuffles -> FAIL 5/7, and the arm would have reached DONE and admitted learning. (b) Admitting learning before terminal DONE -> FAIL 5/7. The first is decisive: it catches a broken control, not merely a broken loop.

claim: An executable causal loop slice constitutes evidence about learning dynamics or emergence.
result: false by construction and stated in the receipt: the learning model carries ONE delta hash and saturates after the first turn (0.70 -> 0.80 -> 0.80). There is no receiver competition, no inhibition, no capacity limit, no Hyperposition, no ClayGraph and no Needle organ. This measures chain completion and control sensitivity only. A completed causal chain is not a mind.

claim: A delegated worker's reported gate results can be accepted as filed.
result: not accepted on report: the coordinating session re-ran the regression and the new gate independently (6/6 and 9/9, 0 mismatches) and added a falsification the worker had not performed - removing the replay guard confirmation_nonce_used from the .clay source turned the gate red with 2000/16000 mismatches, scenario nonce_reused. Evidence outranks worker report.

claim: recovery_cycles_to_0.8 measures post-switch re-adaptation speed.
result: false: rolling-10 window still contains pre-switch successes right after the switch, so the metric reads 1 cycle trivially. Specification error of the experiment author; use pre/post rate difference instead. Metric must not be quoted.

claim: The L0 design can distinguish 'misinformation actively harms' from 'no information'.
result: false: with the thin first-action fallback policy, SHUFFLED, SABOTAGED and NO_REENTRY collapse to bitwise-identical behavior on all 30 seeds — all lesion types are informationally equivalent to 'no data'. Seed 16 additionally shows an unforgiving one-sample evidence rule can waste the truthful information path entirely. L1 (forced exploration + forgiving evidence window) required.

claim: Forced exploration in the EXPLORE fallback plus a forgiving evidence window suffices to separate lesion arms under a fixed-priority policy.
result: false, structurally: the policy checks A0 first and A0 stays permissive forever without own-bucket samples, so no broken arm ever consults evidence and rotation/window never engage; broken arms remained bitwise identical on all 30 seeds. The forgiveness rule reinforces the lock (permissive under scarcity). Fixed by L2's rotating first-consulted action. Second specification error by the experiment author.

claim: The ClayCode evaluator delivered on 2026-08-11 evaluates boolean negation correctly.
result: false: ! was silently dropped by Lark rule inlining after anonymous-token filtering. Minimal repro fn f(a: Bool) -> Bool { if !a { return true } return false } gave f(true)=True, f(false)=False - fully inverted, no error raised. Fixed in PR #314. Also found: BOOLEAN lacked a word boundary, mis-lexing identifiers like false_alarm_rate.

claim: Request-space coverage of a differential gate implies language-construct coverage.
result: false: 200,576 requests over the full EffectRequest space exercised zero uses of the ! operator, because the single source under test does not use it. Construct coverage and request coverage are independent axes. A gate should report which constructs it exercised so an unexercised construct is visible as a gap rather than invisible as a pass.
